milestone: Buyer price test with 5-10 target sponsors (tariff options: 20 bps; $350/account + 3 bps capped at 20 bps; value share)
evidence_obtained: Willingness to pay by segment and balance
stop_if: Fewer than 2 sponsors accept a structure yielding >= 12 bps effective at <= $500k balances
falsifies: 20 bps objective; value-based ceiling at high balances

milestone: Echelon commercial licence terms and second-maintainer plan
evidence_obtained: Executed term sheet or decision to replace PolyForm-NC components
stop_if: Licence cost > $150k/yr or no second maintainer within 6 months

milestone: Payments counsel opinion (money transmission / agent of payee)
stop_if: Licensing required in many states with no partner route

milestone: Auditor conversation: reliance on generated evidence and deterministic release gate (CNV-GOV-001/-003)
stop_if: Auditor will not plan reliance within 24 months

milestone: Design partner letter of intent with prepaid implementation ($100-500k)
Instrumented shadow replay on partner data (exceptions; charity-match recall; December arrival)
evidence_obtained: Measured exception rates and handling minutes
stop_if: Market-mix minutes > 75 after redesign or recall < 98% after fixes

milestone: Engineering spike: 3-5 capabilities under the DEV measurement protocol
evidence_obtained: Human hours and compute per accepted capability; defect escape

milestone: Minimum servicing product build (incl. safety floor)
evidence_obtained: Accepted MSP; pen test; accessibility audit; SOC readiness

milestone: Bank/processor agreement and custodian file access

evidence_obtained: Live operation; SOC Type I or bridge letter

milestone: Board delegation adopted by first sponsor; auditor reliance
stop_if: No delegation within 12 months of go-live

milestone: Second and third sponsors live; deferred-scope tranche
